interface.stateRules: collecting requires reason=observing, units=[], requiresAudioJoin=false. ready requires reason=complete, nonnull sourceOrdinal and exactly one video plus1or2 audio units; selected intervals have overlapping AAC coverage, which is still unverified raw evidence. stopped uses any reason except observing/complete, units=[], requiresAudioJoin=false. unitFields.unit: integer1..3;1 is video;2/3 are audio sorted by startSeconds then startOffset
unitFields.generation: integer1..16; parser init generation of this exact track, never A/V alignment evidence
unitFields.startOffset: integer0..16777215; absolute offset in that track's owned collection byte sequence
unitFields.initLength: integer1..65536 and <=byteLength; exact original init prefix including ftyp if present, no fabricated header
unitFields.startSeconds: finite number0..1000000000 from parsed native-container clock plus observed zero offset
unitFields.endSeconds: finite number greater than startSeconds and <=1000000000; structurally complete interval, not guessed constant length
